about.commitmentDesc: Twiyemeje kurinda ibanga ry'amakuru, kwinjira mu buryo bwizewe, no kubaka ibikoresho bihuye n'uko ibigo bikora buri munsi.
about.label: Ibyerekeye Imboni
about.missionDesc: Koroshya ubuzima bw'ikigo duhuza buri wese ubigizemo uruhare (abanyeshuri, abarimu, ababyeyi n'abakozi b'amacumbi) ku rubuga rumwe rusobanutse kandi rwizewe.
about.quote: "Ikigo kigendera ku itumanaho. Imboni ituma iryo tumanaho risobanuka, rigera ku gihe, kandi rikagera ku bantu bakwiye, buri gihe."
about.serveDesc: Imboni yubakiwe ibigo byakira abanyeshuri bifuza gusobanuka, kugaragaza ukuri no gukora neza muri buri gikorwa cy'ikigo.
about.subtitle: Imboni yateguriwe ibigo byakira abanyeshuri, aho abanyeshuri, abarimu, ababyeyi n'abakozi baba ku kigo bose bakeneye guhora bahujwe kandi bamenyeshwa buri munsi.
about.title: Yubatswe hagendewe ku muryango w'ikigo cyawe

boarding.label: Ubuzima bwo ku kigo
boarding.point1: Gukurikirana imibereho yo mu icumbi no kugenzura buri munsi
boarding.point2: Gucunga inyandiko z'ubuzima no gukurikirana ivuriro
boarding.point3: Raporo z'ibibazo hamwe n'uburyo bwo kumenyesha ababyeyi
boarding.point4: Gukurikirana abanyeshuri hashingiwe ku macumbi yose
boarding.point5: Umuyoboro utaziguye w'itumanaho hagati y'umurezi n'ababyeyi
boarding.point6: Gahunda y'icyumweru itunganyije y'abanyeshuri bose baba ku kigo
boarding.subtitle: Buri cumbi, buri munyeshuri, buri kibazo: bikurikiranwa kandi bikamenyeshwa neza hagati y'abakozi n'ababyeyi.
boarding.title: Kugenzura byuzuye ikigo cyakira abanyeshuri
boarding.visualDesc: Urubuga rw'umurezi n'urw'imyitwarire biha abakozi b'amacumbi uburyo bwo kugenzura ubuzima bwose bwo ku kigo, kuva ku nyandiko z'ubuzima kugeza ku bikorwa by'amacumbi.

contact.label: Twandikire
contact.subtitle: Ufite ikibazo ku kwinjira ku rubuga rwawe, cyangwa ukeneye ubufasha ku makuru yo kwinjira yatanzwe n'ikigo? Vugana n'ibiro by'ikigo tuzagufasha.
contact.title: Turi hano kugufasha

cta.label: Tangira
cta.subtitle: Koresha amakuru yo kwinjira watanzwe n'ikigo kugira ngo ugere ku rubuga rwawe. Vugana n'ibiro by'ikigo niba ukeneye ubufasha.
cta.title: Witeguye kwinjira?

features.analyticsDesc: Ishusho nzima y'uko imikorere ihagaze, igipimo cy'ubwitabire n'ibyavuye mu bizamini.

features.messagingDesc: Ubutumwa butaziguye hagati y'abarimu, ababyeyi n'abakozi b'amacumbi, nta zindi porogaramu zikenewe.
features.mobileDesc: Bikora neza ku gikoresho cyose: telefone, tableti cyangwa mudasobwa. Nta porogaramu ugomba gushyiraho.

features.secureDesc: Buri mukoresha areba gusa ibimureba. Amakuru yo kwinjira atangwa n'ikigo arinda ibanga ry'amakuru.
features.smartDesc: Amatangazo y'ingenzi ageraho abanyeshuri, abarimu n'ababyeyi icyarimwe.

features.title: Byubakiwe uko ibigo bikora koko
